description.value: Joe Fortes Seafood & Chop House is a celebrated Vancouver institution operating for over 35 years, named after Seraphim 'Joe Fortes,' the city's first official lifeguard. The restaurant spans multiple distinctive spaces — a horseshoe oyster bar grand room, mezzanine with live music, mahogany-walled wine room, and a rooftop garden with a living green wall and outdoor fireplace. It is known for its daily-sourced Pacific Northwest seafood, 300-bottle award-winning wine list, and loyal following of locals, tourists, and celebrities.
